## Reviewer Checklist

- [ ] All affected Features are identified.
- [ ] All relevant Development Tasks are linked.
- [ ] The corresponding Feature-level Code Review Tasks are linked.
- [ ] Change Sets and commits are associated with the correct Development Tasks.
- [ ] No unrelated changes are included.
- [ ] Developer testing has been completed.
- [ ] No unresolved merge conflicts remain.

## Workflow Notes

- QA verification happens against builds generated from `main`.
- Do not use `Closes`, `Fixes`, or `Resolves` keywords for work items. Work item resolution is controlled by the Work Item Manager and the responsible agent.
- Every affected Feature must pass its required code review before merging.
